name: Red Linen Goods
label: Quest
description: At Eastvale Logging Camp, Sara Timberlain needs cloth for her tailoring. She asks passing adventurers to hunt Defias bandits and take their linen…
intro: At Eastvale Logging Camp, Sara Timberlain needs cloth for her tailoring. She asks passing adventurers to hunt Defias bandits and take their linen bandanas, then uses the cloth to make goods for travelers.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Defias gang in Northshire wears burlap masks, but the Defias in Elwynn wear linen which I can use to make fine linen goods.
Bring me red linen bandanas and I'll use them to fashion something for you.
Defias gang members have camps pocketed throughout Elwynn.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I'm running low on linen, friend. Do you have any for me?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, these are nice bandanas, if a little rough...
